title: Reindexed junta witness coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $P,J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be coordinate sets. Enumerate the coordinates outside $P$ by positions in a set of size equal to the number of coordinates outside $P$. The reindexed witness coordinates are the positions in this enumeration whose corresponding original coordinates belong to $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $P,J$ are finite sets of coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$
caveat: The supplied material does not define the referenced fixed-index type, so the identification of the enumeration with coordinates outside $P$ is inferred from its dimension and use.
